spacecraft.description: Clean-room synthetic spacecraft for Orb Lab uncertainty and intersection experiments. Physical and maneuver assumptions are inspired by PRISMA Mango; drag and POD uncertainty assumptions are informed by GRACE-FO research context.

physical_agility.name: PRISMA Mango
physical_agility.usage: mass, compact geometry, formation-flying mission personality, and 1 N class small-spacecraft propulsion reference

drag_pod.name: GRACE-FO
drag_pod.usage: public reference for drag, non-gravitational acceleration, GNSS, ranging, and POD uncertainty research

geometry.reference: 0.8 m class PRISMA Mango public dimension summary

calibration_reference.name: GRACE-FO
calibration_reference.note: Future increments may tune drag and covariance behavior against public GRACE-FO accelerometer and POD research products.

altitude_km.note: Seeded near PRISMA public sun-synchronous orbit range; exact generated ephemeris belongs to a later increment.

uncertainty.note: Increment 2 defines covariance shape, frame, units, sigma level, and growth strategy.
